scope: Four-source fixed-load native component control; not a full-module or full-scene headline.
multi_rhs_layout: Each contact is a separate native solve call with B independent RHS environments; four sources are never folded into one aggregated RHS in A or per_contact_common_q.
aggregation_scope: B/C sum all four saved weighted native scatter loads on device inside every timed iteration; pressure, feature selection and topology/factor/response setup are excluded.
empty_work_policy: All four contact slots and every prepared group execute; only native active-environment masks skip factor/product work. No host empty-source skipping.
spin_policy: Six native mother spin response columns are prepared once; physical replay adds the saved spin once per iteration, while signed-cancellation replay sets omega=0 in every path.
criterion_implementation: A/B use a research QD kernel with the same six-component symmetric tensor VM formula in native solve/shell scans; current engine has no standalone tensor-input criterion function. Never sum per-source VM/peaks.
timing_protocol: Warm every path, rotate repetition order, sync before/after timed batches; all readback, equivalence checks and exports occur afterwards.

incremental_controls.grouping_control: per_contact_common_q and C both recover the complete stress once: four independent source solves/merges versus on-device feature RHS grouping and grouped solves.
incremental_controls.merged_recovery_control: B and C use the same grouped feature solve/gate/lift workload; B scans each group and spin separately and adds tensors, while C adds q and scans once.
incremental_controls.scope: Observed four-path component differences at identical saved loads/samples; A/B also changes the declared number of stress scans, so its ratio is not an isolated aggregation-kernel speedup. No rigid or pressure/selection timing.

signed_cancellation.scope: Optional algebra diagnostic on saved native weighted raw loads only; original pressure/contact files and their physical baseline validation are unchanged.
signed_cancellation.field_rule: Use [1,-1/1.13,0,0] times the four saved source candidate/reference linear fields and zero spin; derive VM/peak only after total tensor summation. Never combine source peaks.
signed_cancellation.acceptance: Only original native solve gates and four-path equivalence determine passed. Near-cancellation observation and unchanged spatial budget flags are reported diagnostics.
signed_cancellation.norm_metric: Stress tensor uses native sample area/volume-weighted Frobenius norm with shear multiplicity two; q/N/M/Q use their complete sampled Euclidean norms. Source denominator is sum(abs(coefficient) * saved source reference norm).
